content: Mwor nure wuro nobo woo non nawori natubo komkwamredor bwetub kumebbo nen, natubo kom neken ner kumero bwetub kumebonen, tano kannyem cimbo mani ciya bwanka ker kwama kotiri, mulen natubo locinbo tamci, cimanki kertak, Yiilam natubo lociye men.
Nyo cin tom fwor nere mwe bijin kemwo nene.
Yori kabo bwayilen kumero ayilare na toka nuwe koce kakaa-natobwinnece mwin kange kulen.
No daten maka mwor neret na dige yorako manki diika na fwor neret na nimde kwama ce.
Nyo dige natubo dimce kako cume wo yoo ner kii kwama di ciki bwici cin neken nabarub cibo bilinkerer.
mwor nure woo cera ciya lan cuwo Abraham ki teluwe ce na moo caneu co bi beyo loce no mun maa dignge dateneri dii kange no mu man ki tai dotangeri

Mwor nure win, koom nabarubo kom yi kange natub kumebbo ano mwor cwikanka kimek, na bulendo won corbo bwiniyeu, na nawiye, kom neci biduwed na luma kwali dume. Kamati nyo naci nuwa luma dilo kumekoti.
Takka ker gwam kume kii dume cerkang bwitiyeu nyo ri nob cwikangka bwiti kume ko neka ciyaka nerkumer kange kungne.
Mani mwa ya cuner bwiranketti ki bwiranket, mani mwa ya cunet ti kibi tor ko bitor nyo naki yaken kange bilanka, nawo ci cuneneu nawo mwati fiya bilanka.
Nii wo cwiti ci nwa luma tiyeri an to kume ken ca dubum biyen cero tokka kero bwid.
Nacuri dubom nure bwira yeu naci ma diker yoriyeu la ca do luma na cilamco.
Dii nuwe kwama nii ken la too ceu nuwa bicorcero la tikob kwama boki no nubo ma biran kereu.
Wee woo nii wora woo anuwam tiye no man mwaa mwe dikero yoradi?
Na no mu nuwa dotange ki den bilenkerdi, cware diker ci cwa tiyeu, ciyare dotange.
Nyori neken yecu kritti mor neremweu ki nero wucak. Tii kibati na ciya cowe nii menen ki yee muntim kibikwan fiye kwama wiye. ma yoki mor luma kunde dor bwangten naco.
Fiyam yumkako daten nubo ma kukla mweko tiyeu, yim kale mwembo keneu mwor kritti catin nuwa kwenduwe diker bwiyeu na dikero muke ma bweran keret.
Daten na kwama cwinki mwan nuwa dotange bilenker na nubo ma bwiran kerer tiyeu.

Kritti na bwiyaka kiritti win ki den bwiran kerer. Niwo ki bilenkeu a nuwa dota-nge dorber, nobo manki bilenkereu, nyori naci bou kibo kwama nen. cin dokken co bwar mwor bwiye la ci macodi dume ki yuwa tangbe.
Ki yuwa tangbe cin nya ci bweldo biro bwaban'ngum bwaba-nge.
Diger dateneu be nwo birom nerem kwama cenciti ki cur nowa ki kumeni nuwa ywel tokombe, la kwama fulo nubo cwabce nubo narub ceri ki kwama mweme.
Woo co dankako yuka mwengek cokom nen na we kebo na yuka mwengek ko cokum dwitito bwimweu, La daten kinonka kwama kange kong yecu Almaciya.
Kritti ki no kanko cattiyed kwamar incuuken firen di kwama, bwatomange kwama bikwan keret kange bikwan tom nyo an neken co.
